meta.title: No regret on a withdrawn event
gaps: The vendor's regret operation is not available in the provided operations, and no request path was supplied for it.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor opens a bid on the pricing round.
The buyer withdraws the event with the status set to “withdrawn”.
As the buyer, read the event and check that the event is still active (not withdrawn).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Trade Request not found”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the event is still active (not withdrawn).

plan.title: No regret on a withdrawn event

assert.say: the event is still active (not withdrawn)
